findings.desc: CHK-001:edge:0 evidence note overclaims: the intent 'A normal no-hazard story proceeds through the existing done_prepare flow unchanged except for clearer status text' is bound to the second run inside assertMetadataCommitNoRebindAndAutoCloseExit (done-prepare-merge-rerun-smoke.ts:490-507), but that scenario is NOT a normal/default no-hazard run — it requires a prior BLOCKED run, a manual commit of generated metadata, and non-default flags autoCloseGeneratedMetadata=true + reuseFreshValidation=true. The resulting PASS transcript is not 'unchanged except for clearer status text': injectAutoCloseoutSummary() (done-prepare.ts:1292-1308, invoked at line 1867) splices in an extra autoCloseGeneratedMetadata: PASS / autoCloseoutCommit: / autoCloseoutFiles: block that a genuinely normal no-hazard done_prepare call never prints. No scenario in this smoke file exercises a plain first-run, no-special-flags, no-hazard done_prepare reaching PASS (the only literal 'DONE prepare: PASS' assertion in the file is this auto-closeout one; assertDryRunNoMutation only asserts PASS|BLOCKED, not PASS specifically). Recommend either adding a dedicated no-hazard-default-flow PASS assertion, or correcting the CHK-001:edge:0 intent/evidence note to describe the auto-closeout scenario actually tested.
